title: Accounts Assistant
company: Three Bridges Recruitment LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Three Bridges Recruitment is working with a leading not-for-profit organisation in Edinburgh who are looking for an Accounts Assistant to support day-to-day donation processing and frontline customer service. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with basic finance experience who is looking to grow their skills within a supportive, values-led environment.

Why work here?

This organisation has a strong social mission and a deep community presence. People join because they want to contribute to meaningful work and stay because the environment is warm, steady and collaborative. You'll benefit from:
- Salary of £27,000
- 36 days' annual leave (pro-rata during the temporary period)
- Hybrid working after probation
- Flexible start and finish times
- A supportive and friendly team
- Regular social events and a culture grounded in care and purpose

This is a fantastic role for someone early in their finance career who wants to develop their skills while contributing to work with genuine impact.

Job

As Accounts Assistant, you'll sit within a finance team of five and work closely with colleagues across the organisation. Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing donations and payments with accuracy and care
- Managing weekly payment runs for approval
- Reviewing purchase ledger statements and carrying out reconciliations
- Resolving queries in a warm, empathetic and professional manner
- Creating and updating database records
- Supporting administrative tasks including preparing letters and stakeholder communication
- Handling financial transaction processing
- Assisting the wider team with finance queries
- Filing, scanning and general administration

You will begin primarily office-based in Edinburgh, receiving close support as you settle in, with the option to transition to hybrid working after probation.

This is a 6-month temporary role with genuine potential to become permanent.

You

As an Accounts Assistant, you will bring:
- Strong communication skills and a high degree of empathy
- A genuine desire to develop within a finance role
- Basic finance experience and/or administration or customer service experience
- A positive, can-do approach
- Calmness under pressure and strong attention to detail
- Good organisational skills and time management
- Confident use of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

You'll thrive here if you enjoy being part of a caring, values-driven team and take pride in delivering accurate, reliable work.

About the Organisation

This is a respected not-for-profit organisation with a long track record of supporting communities across Scotland. The culture is grounded, human and purpose-led. People work with care and commitment, and the finance team reflects those same values: detail-focused, reliable and service-oriented. Your work will support the organisation's ability to deliver its mission and maintain the services relied upon by individuals and families across the country.

Interested?

At Three Bridges Recruitment, two of our values are "striving for brilliance" and "relatability". We want every applicant to receive an excellent experience and to feel confident that this role is right for them.If this opportunity sounds like a good fit, please apply with your most up-to-date CV or contact us for a confidential discussion.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller - Edinburgh

Location: Edinburgh
Salary: £30,000-£35,000
Contract: Permanent
Start Date: ASAP

We're working with a well-established business in Edinburgh who are looking to appoint an experienced Credit Controller to join their finance team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with strong credit control experience who enjoys working with customers, managing their own ledger and taking a proactive approach to cash collection.

The Role

Reporting into the Finance Manager, you'll take responsibility for managing an allocated customer ledger and ensuring outstanding debts are collected efficiently and professionally.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing an allocated customer ledger and monitoring outstanding balances.
- Proactively contacting customers by phone and email to recover overdue payments.
- Building strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
- Investigating and resolving invoice and payment queries.
- Allocating cash and ensuring customer accounts are kept up to date.
- Monitoring aged debt and escalating potential issues where required.
- Working closely with the wider finance team to improve cash collection and reduce overdue debt.
- Preparing regular aged debt reports and providing updates on collection performance.
- Supporting with account reconciliations and other finance duties as required.
- Identifying opportunities to improve credit control processes and procedures.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience in a Credit Controller or similar accounts receivable position.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- Confidence speaking with customers regarding outstanding payments.
- Good attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- The ability to manage a busy ledger and prioritise effectively.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and collecting debt.
- Good Excel and general systems skills.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a wider finance team.

This would suit an experienced Credit Controller looking for their next opportunity in Edinburgh, or someone with solid Accounts Receivable experience who is ready to take on more responsibility.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. title: HR Assistant
description:
Edinburgh or Glasgow Hybrid Working Full-Time

I'm working with a respected professional services organisation looking to appoint an HR Assistant to join their established People team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration skills who is looking to develop a career in HR, or for an experienced HR Administrator seeking a varied role with exposure across the full employee lifecycle.

Key responsibilities:
- Provide HR administration support across the employee lifecycle, ensuring records and documentation remain accurate.
- Act as a first point of contact for HR queries, delivering a professional and responsive service.
- Support recruitment, onboarding and induction activity for new employees.
- Maintain and update the HR system, producing reports and assisting with people data requirements.
- Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, policy updates and wider team initiatives.

What we're looking for:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within HR, recruitment or a people-focused environment.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm in a busy environment.
- Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information.
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn and contribute to continuous improvement.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive team where you'll gain broad HR exposure, build new skills and play an important role within a well-established organisation.

To apply for this role, please send your CV or contact Anthony Oliva at Iconic Resourcing for a confidential chat and further details. At Iconic Resourcing, we understand that not all candidates will meet every single desired qualification or skill for the job positions posted on behalf of our clients.

However, if you believe you can add value to the role despite your experience looking a little different from what we've outlined, we would be thrilled to learn more about you.

title: Language Speaking Credit Controller - Fully remote
description:
European Credit Controller - FTC until May 2027

- Focusing on maximising cash collection and working towards targets
- Prior experience of working with Oracle is also highly advantageous
- Chasing high value and complex old debt (150+ days)
- Managing complex queries and disputes through to resolution
- Ensuring all updates are logged in a timely manner on system
- Adhering to country specific legal and financial regulations
- Proactively alert management to any potential compliance issues

Skills Required:
- Proven experience within commercial debt collection/credit control is essential
- Fluency in at least one European language alongside English is essential (French, Italian, Spanish, German, Dutch, Turkish, Portuguese, Greek, Bulgarian, Slovak, Slovenian, Hungarian)
- Experience of working on ERP's such as Oracle & SAP advantageous
- Excellent communication skills, strong at negotiation and dispute resolution
- Proven ability to work in a target driven environment
- Excellent time management skills
- Ability to work of own initiative
- Self motivated, with the ability to multitask and prioritise

If you are interested in this vacancy please contact Sarah Chandler at CWC Recruitment Ltd.

CWC is a specialist recruitment consultancy dedicated to recruiting credit professionals. We have over 45 years of credit control and credit management recruitment experience. We are true experts within our field.
